findings.issue: Substring matcher can count unrelated code unsupported as a port diagnostic, and descriptive selected text as corrective action.
findings.repair: Require admitted exact diagnostic codes and a clear corrective-action contract; add otherwise-valid false-positive controls.

findings.issue: Unknown added resources are retained only after the original preservation assertion. Combined original drift and unknown added resource takes Fatal before RetainForRecovery; inventory-read failure also exits before marking uncertainty retained.
findings.repair: Mark uncertain or unqualified fixture retained before any fatal path, preserving strict baseline failure.

findings.issue: Added network qualification accepts zero endpoints even when the qualified broker is running, without a fresh reciprocal container attachment check.
findings.repair: Require the exact original endpoint plus reciprocal attachment when running. Permit empty endpoint only for separately admitted stopped transition; otherwise retain/refuse.
